text:
emma: Heads up — FinBank wants an exception to run tenant data in a nonstandard APAC region (APAC-NE). They require no egress to EU/US, BYOK/KMS in their HSM, and a signed subprocessors list for that region. Can we support for a POC? cc @liam @maria
liam: Doable but it's not a standard region in infra. Need to confirm subproc coverage and whether we can pin in Dedicated or Private. @nate do we have APAC-NE infra?
nate: We don't have a managed region there. Options: 1) Private deploy in their VPC, or 2) route to nearest APAC region and use tenant pinning with egress controls. Both have ops/infra and cost implications.
emma: Customer wants hosted POC first — they won't do Private for POC. Is there a short-term routing exception we can offer?
maria: Presales: we can do a geo-fence / tenant pin to APAC-SE for POC but must document egress + subproc delta. Also BYOK: we can accept a customer-provided KMS with Dedicated/Private; hosted doesn't support BYOK today.
liam: Can we do BYOK for hosted? I thought we had a path via KMS federation.
sara: Hosted BYOK is not allowed for that region due to subprocessor contracts. Also FinBank needs subproc attestation with org-level names — that'll take 7-10 business days.
nate: Workaround for POC: spin up temporary Dedicated pool in APAC-SE reserved for the customer; we can restrict egress and provide a trimmed subproc list (only infra provider). Cost: estimate ~+$X/day for the pool + ops setup. Need pricing to share.
emma: :thinking_face: Customer asked for pricing — what's the delta vs standard POC?
maria: Estimate: +30-40% for dedicated pool + ops setup fee. I'll draft a quote. Also need to surface SLA expectations — can offer best-effort POC SLAs.
liam: Operational checklist for sales to confirm with customer: 1) Will they accept APAC-SE instead of APAC-NE? 2) BYOK required? 3) Can they sign a temporary subproc NDA? 4) Expected QPS and model size? Post answers, we can size Dedicated.
nate: I'll need network egress IPs list for their firewall. Also cert chain for HSM (if BYOK) and timeline for HSM setup — typically 3-5 days for cert exchange.
sara: Also require data processing addendum and updated subproc disclosure. If they need no EU/US egress ever, we need Private or on-prem for prod.
emma: I'll get answers today. Sales ask: is there a standard 'residency-exception' pricing SKU we can use?
maria: No standard SKU. I'll create a quick pricing template and hand off to finance for sign-off.
liam: If customer wants hosted POC with tenant pin + egress ACLs, technically possible but needs ops-runbook and signoff from legal/security. Ops can probably run it if customer signs risk waiver.
nate: Ops note: we need a runbook item list. I'll prep a doc and ping @ops-bot to kick an incident channel when ready.
ops-bot: created #ops-finbank-poc with runbook template. Link: https://internal/redwood/ops/finbank-poc
emma: Thanks — I'll update the customer and loop back with answers. :thumbsup:
